selection.tie_rule: earliest target_id at the exact maximum; a later row inside the effect floor is not added

effect_floor_reason: Declared after numerical preflight and before the Generation 6 census. The predeclared rule is: keep 1e-8 when the worst reference numerical gap is below 1e-10. Do not use scientific |I| magnitudes to move the floor. Reference systems, chosen by structure and not by extremum, are the unconstrained baseline, the v0.5 prohibit/prohibit anchor, one strong_suppress/strong_suppress target of the same geometry and polarity, one strong_favour/strong_favour target of the same geometry and polarity, the anchor's condition-erased control, and one live pair-face of the anchor (control id 95,1050). Maximum block-versus-dense landing gap: 1.1102230246251565e-16. Maximum block-versus-dense committor gap: 4.440892098500626e-16. Maximum direct-versus-iterative committor gap: 3.397282455352979e-14, on the condition-erased control. Interaction identity gap: 0. Anchor state-resolved direct-versus-iterative gap: 2.015054789694659e-14. Worst of those gaps: 3.397282455352979e-14, which is below 1e-10, so the floor stays 1e-8. The anchor-versus-published interaction gap, 3.3306690738754696e-16, is a reproduction check and is not an input to the floor. Float64 solutions are not exact. The floor is not retuned after the census.

execution.principle: Prefer bounded, independently reproducible, idempotent units of work with durable checkpoints, so completed progress is monotonic and interruption is cheap.
execution.profile_note: Measured 2026-10-03 on this development machine, one worker, OMP/OPENBLAS/MKL threads 1. Binding window: N=4, K<=2, cardinality 2, combination ranks 4000:8000, 3262 canonical-simple float64 kernels, 66.7s. N=3, K<=3, cardinality 3, ranks 180000:190000 analysed 9399 rational kernels in 13.6s. The N=3 opening prefix is cheap (ranks 0:1000 analysed nothing) because weights are innermost, so early combinations stack grades on the first structures. 4000 items keeps the measured worst window inside 60-90s and under 120s.
